title: KernelArtifactTagSchema
description: Canonical schema for kernel-artifact YAML frontmatter fields. Authored by the Retrieval lobe per _dev/concepts/retrieval-lobe/concept.md:46. Every kernel-written artifact (concept.md, memory file, debrief, convene synthesis, task plan, signal, doctrine canonical text) must carry frontmatter conforming to the six required fields declared here. Consumed by tools/kernel/lib/retrieval-adapter.cjs (Control Loop's reflex check #1 hand-off seam) and by tools/retrieval/ (this lobe's search/lookup surfaces). additionalProperties=true so frontmatter remains extensible for per-artifact-class fields.

similarity_tags.description: Controlled-vocabulary tag list plus free-text tags (free-text flagged).

domain.description: Primary domain of the artifact (e.g., kernel, client, framework).

surfaces.description: File/path surfaces the artifact touches or references.

related_artifacts.description: Reachable artifact paths for related-work graph traversal.

kernel_level.description: Actor-tier the artifact is authored at.
